facts: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos after dropping out of Stanford University in the fall of 2003.
Theranos has raised more than $400 million from equity sales, valuing the company at over $9 billion.
The company offers blood diagnostic tests using only a few drops of blood collected via a finger stick into a nanotainer.
Theranos tests are priced to never exceed half the Medicare reimbursement rate for each procedure and are posted online.
Walgreens committed in September to establish Theranos collection centers in a substantial percentage of its 8,200 drugstores.
Theranos operates a 262,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Newark, California.
